purpose: The canonical, immutable Stage 3F inheritance boundary for Stage 3G: verify, bind, canonicalize, freeze. No scientific conclusion is created or changed.

hashTypes.BOUND_SEMANTIC_HASH: the self-hash a certified document embeds (e.g. certificationHash, claimMapHash, contractHash): sha256 of JSON.stringify(document without that field). The canonical scientific identifier bound by the certificate chain.
hashTypes.RAW_FILE_SHA256: sha256 of the committed file bytes. Artifact integrity only; never a substitute for a bound semantic hash.
hashTypes.SECTION_HASH: sha256 of JSON.stringify(section) for a section of this freeze (IMMUTABLE_FACTS_HASH and the other *_HASH values below).

TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED.means: transition prediction is not the first demonstrated bottleneck; only one-step successor value has been measured.
TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED.doesNotMean: multistep predictive world models have been disproven.
TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED.certifiedQualification: as the first bottleneck; only single-step successors were measured

POLICY_QUALITY_PRIMARY_BOTTLENECK.means: policy quality dominates selection/routing limitations on the certified corpus.
POLICY_QUALITY_PRIMARY_BOTTLENECK.doesNotMean: policy quality is the primary bottleneck beyond the certified corpus (not generalized beyond that evidence).
POLICY_QUALITY_PRIMARY_BOTTLENECK.certifiedQualification: relative to selection; the policies are themselves limited by representation (H2)

immutableFacts.scope: Facts about the certified Stage 3F corpus and experts (FORGE_SYMMETRIC_V2 lineage, sealed HOLDOUT/OOD) under R0. They are not claims about other corpora, games or future representations.

principles.DDV: Downstream Decision Value is the primary future model-selection criterion.
principles.TCA: Trust-Conditioned Advantage is the primary future trust-gated decision-value criterion.
principles.CR: Counterfactual Regret measures value lost through incorrect counterfactual ranking.
principles.CAD: Counterfactual Action Discrimination measures whether candidate futures remain distinguishable.
principles.FPE: Factual Prediction Error is diagnostic and does not establish useful planning competence on its own.
principles.ranking: As frozen in the contract: DDV on sealed HOLDOUT and OOD, then TCA, then CR; FPE and CAD never decide a ranking on their own.

decisionEvaluationContract.canonicalRule: LOWER FACTUAL PREDICTION LOSS DOES NOT IMPLY BETTER DECISION VALUE.
decisionEvaluationContract.tournamentRule: No learned world model may win the Stage 3I tournament solely because it has the lowest reconstruction, latent, or next-state prediction loss. Ranking is by DDV on sealed HOLDOUT and OOD, then TCA, then CR; FPE and CAD are reported diagnostics and never decide a ranking on their own.
decisionEvaluationContract.stage3iRule: A Stage 3I world model may not win solely because it achieves lower reconstruction, latent, or factual prediction loss.

distinction.SCIENTIFIC_REPRODUCIBILITY: Identical dataset / corpus content hashes; identical discrete outputs (policy and action selections, routing decisions, thresholds and tiers chosen, rankings, classifications, conclusions, roadmap flags); continuous metrics within the frozen output tolerance.
distinction.BYTE_REPRODUCIBILITY: Identical serialised artifacts and hashes, computed under SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1.
distinction.rule: Scientific reproducibility (identical data, decisions, classifications and conclusions) holds under host-native numerics as well; byte reproducibility of certificates holds only under SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1. Host-native math never changes a scientific conclusion in the Stage 3F-RP evidence, and it never certifies.

requiredLevel.note: Every class keeps the byte-level requirement it had; it is strengthened from "on the certifying host" to "on every host", by computing under SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1. Level B and Level A are diagnostic comparisons for runs under host-native numerics; they never certify.

checkModeInvariant.appliesTo: every certification or verification --check path introduced from the Stage 3F freeze onward

guard.behaviour: in check mode any write, append, rename, copy-over, truncation, deletion or open-for-write of a git-tracked path throws (identical rewrites included); the tracked tree must be unchanged at exit or the process exits 3

enforcement.test: tests/stage3f-freeze.test.js (every script matching futureCertifierPattern installs the guard; the freeze --check runs with zero tracked-write attempts)
enforcement.runtime: scripts/reproducibility/run-canonical.mjs (SENTINEL_READONLY=1) additionally blocks differing writes for every Stage 3F check

checkModeInvariant.source: Governance rule declared by the Stage 3F freeze from the Stage 3F-RP check-mode audit; not a scientific claim.

certifierChainException.reason: Stage 3F-RP seals the Stage 3F chain (scripts/reproducibility/stage3f-chain.mjs) and its chain-coverage test requires every certify-stage3f* measurement certifier to be a link in it. The Stage 3F.6-CR certifier executes that chain itself (a meta-certifier), so it cannot be a link and is intentionally named outside the certify-stage3f* pattern. Renaming it for naming consistency would break the certified Stage 3F-RP chain rule; the exception is frozen instead.

otherMetaCertifiers.scripts/certify-stage3frp-reproducibilit: matches the pattern by name but is excluded explicitly by the Stage 3F-RP chain-coverage test (it certifies the chain)
otherMetaCertifiers.scripts/stage3f-freeze-certify.mjs: freeze certifier; runs the chain through the CR certifier; outside the pattern

epistemicProvenance.basis: Every Stage 3F result turned on separating deployable, privileged (simulator) and oracle information (3F.6-S contract; privileged one-step predictions; oracle labels). The E0-E5 level scale is not defined anywhere in the repository; Stage 3G must define it before use.
epistemicProvenance.rule: Every input and prediction must declare its provenance (deployable, privileged/simulator, oracle). The level scale (E0-E5 or an equivalent) is not defined in the repository and is not frozen here; Stage 3G must define it before use.

OBSERVABLE_ENTITY_STATE_REQUIRED.basis: The free-action decision is limited by partial observability of task-entity positions (P.1A-SYM H2).

ACTOR_RELATIVE_SPATIAL_REPRESENTATION_RE.basis: The recoverable gain is where movement leads relative to the task entities (P.1-SYM, W-SYM privileged geometry).
ACTOR_RELATIVE_SPATIAL_REPRESENTATION_RE.canonicalization: the single Stage 3F.6-CR requirement is named here by its two components (actor-relative and action-relative); no requirement is added

ACTION_RELATIVE_SPATIAL_REPRESENTATION_R.basis: The recoverable gain is where movement leads relative to the task entities (P.1-SYM, W-SYM privileged geometry).
ACTION_RELATIVE_SPATIAL_REPRESENTATION_R.canonicalization: the single Stage 3F.6-CR requirement is named here by its two components (actor-relative and action-relative); no requirement is added

STRUCTURED_ACTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRED.basis: Missing capability is observation and action-semantics infrastructure (P.1A-SYM, P.1-SYM).

PREDICTION_LIFECYCLE_REQUIRED.basis: FPE requires predictions recorded at decision time and bound to outcomes; Stage 3F.6 found most prediction classes unavailable or with placeholder confidence.

COUNTERFACTUAL_DISCRIMINATION_EVALUATION.basis: Policies fail to discriminate among equal-cost candidates (87-95% of states have an optimal zero-cost action).

COUNTERFACTUAL_REGRET_EVALUATION_REQUIRE.basis: Every Stage 3F verdict is regret-based; accuracy and regret diverge (T-SYM mixed trade-off).

DOWNSTREAM_DECISION_VALUE_EVALUATION_REQ.basis: Component gains did not become decision value: W router gain was threshold not information; decision-rule gains reversed on OOD.

STAGE_WISE_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED.basis: Stage 3F only became diagnosable by separating feature derivation, equation, binding (3F.6), action type versus target (P.1-SYM) and threshold versus information (W-SYM).

EPISTEMIC_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED.basis: Every Stage 3F result turned on separating deployable, privileged (simulator) and oracle information (3F.6-S contract; privileged one-step predictions; oracle labels). The E0-E5 level scale is not defined anywhere in the repository; Stage 3G must define it before use.

WORLD_MODEL_TRUST_GATE.basis: False-selection harm is unacceptable and confidence rose with novelty in Stage 3F.6; a gate is needed before any predictive component influences recommendations. Not specified here.

TASK_STATE_CONTAMINATION_TRACKING.basis: Direction, identity-order and layout shortcuts contaminated Forge V1 results until the symmetric lineage; contamination must be tracked, not rediscovered.

LARGE_LEARNED_WORLD_MODEL.reason: no Stage 3F evidence; transition prediction is not the first bottleneck

ROUTER_2_0_REQUIRED.reason: ROUTER_2_0_JUSTIFIED=false in T-SYM, P.1A-SYM, P.1-SYM, W-SYM and D-SYM

AUTHORITY_INCREASE_REQUIRED.reason: R0 is required; nothing supports an increase

stage3gEntryRequirements.rule: Stage 3G inherits these requirements; it does not inherit any implementation. Planned items are not mandatory implementations; not-required items stay outside the Stage 3F inheritance.

provenance.note: No machine-readable roster artifact existed in the repository before this freeze; the canonical roster is bound here as declared, not derived from a measurement. It is consistent with the certified record: Stage 3F.6-CR keeps EXPERT_10 outside the inheritance (no Stage 3F evidence).

documentedDiscrepancy.text: the pre-Stage-3F roadmap lists "Strategist" among expert packets; it is not in the canonical roster and is not added or reclassified by this freeze

P.1A-SYM --check requires P.1C, P.1D, P.1E and 3F.6-T-SYM to reproduce byte for byte

reproducedBy.rule: W_SYM byte-exact => P1_SYM reproduced => P1A_SYM reproduced => 3F6P1C, 3F6P1D, 3F6P1E and T_SYM reproduced; every stage of the chain is recomputed on each freeze --check.

erratum.hashType: RAW_FILE_SHA256 (the erratum embeds no self-hash; this is the identity Stage 3F.6-CR binds as erratumSha256)

historicalStage3F6.rule: The historical Stage 3F.6 certificate is not reproducible at any commit and is never re-run as though it were; the erratum is part of the frozen record.

onCertificationPass.rule: These values take effect only through a PASS certificate of this freeze (scripts/stage3f-freeze-certify.mjs).
